profile_text.body:
Curriculum Associates describes itself as delivering evidence-based curriculum and assessment, and says it works with one million educators to connect assessment, instruction, and data. Its i-Ready portfolio combines assessment with core and supplemental instruction. The site also presents Ellevation, described as an all-in-one English language development platform serving nearly half the nation's English Learners, and Stile, a middle school science curriculum customized for every state. The company states it partners with 6sense for marketing and advertising, using hashed email addresses from submitted forms to identify organizations and deliver advertising across devices and channels.

The tracked product is i-Ready, listed under education and research AI, with adaptive diagnostic and lesson features used for adaptive diagnostic and instruction by students in kindergarten through eighth grade and their teachers. The note records that it was found in research for The AI Ready School and was not independently verified, and that student age and privacy details were not verified. Pricing is recorded as i-Ready Assessment at $8 per student or a site license of $1,130 to $4,670 by enrollment, based on a California state filing, with instruction priced separately; the note cautions that this covers assessment pricing only.

No lawsuits or MCP servers are recorded for the company.
